subject: 藏地石木平顶马厩（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create exactly ONE isolated city-map sprite for tianshu, historical Tibetan regional kit. Realistic ancient material detail and crisp restrained weathering matching the attached Song reference; reinterpret the subject in Tibetan stone/wood/cloth construction, not Chinese gray-tiled gables. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection, yaw45 pitch30, NO perspective convergence. BOTH ground axes MUST form exactly slopes +0.5 and -0.5 in screen space, opposite edges parallel, upright vertical posts. The ground-plane bounding diamond must be twice as wide as high. Thin natural ground contact, clearly visible LEFT, FRONT and RIGHT ground corners; no thick display slab. South/front faces screen lower left. Opaque solid object with real RGBA background transparency; no luminous rim, haze, glow, baked white or checkerboard. Warm-neutral light from screen UPPER LEFT, tiny short soft contact shadow lower right. Entire asset centered with at least10% transparent margins, no cropping. No people, animals, writing, marks resembling lettering, shop signs, watermark, labels, grid, modern elements, background scenery, road, sky, floating island, diorama base, cartoon or toy. Original generic regional adaptation; not a named historical monument. Asset ID bld_kit_tubo_stable. Single rural Tibetan horse stable, original generic non-monumental architecture.8m east-west by6m north-south nearly-square rectangular footprint, ground edge ratio exactly4:3. One low storey with flat compacted-earth roof and very low rough-stone parapet, solid whitewashed fieldstone rear and side walls, broad south-facing open stable front facing lower left; dark timber lintel supported by three stout wood posts, two unoccupied stalls with plain wooden mangers and small restrained hay bundles. No horse or other animal. Two small plain dark vents in side wall; no tiled roof, painted palace ornament, flags or porch tower. Rough gray footing and thin packed-earth rectangle with all corners readable. Ground positions approximately LEFT(0.18,0.61), FRONT(0.5457,0.7929), RIGHT(0.82,0.6557), BACK(0.4543,0.4729), so both ground-edge slopes are+0.5/-0.5. Do not print any coordinates or labels. Preserve warm earthy texture and believable stable scale.
